newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Ministers agree new fish marketing rules.
newsitem.headline: Ministers agree new fish marketing rules.

text.p: Fisheries ministers reached political agreement on a compromise text to revise fish marketing standards from January 2000, EU officials said on Monday.

Agreement was reached after the Irish EU Presidency suggested firstly delaying from January 1997 the exclusion of category B fish from EU financial aid and secondly allowing producer groups to continue giving aid from their own resources.
Only the "extra" and "A" categories will in future be eligible for EU aid.
The agreement consolidates regulations 103/76 and 104/76 in a single text and updates standareds to include improvements in fish handling and marketing over the past 20 years.
It also simplifies freshness criteria and is aimed at improving marketing quality.
